author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: In 3CX go to Admin > Integrations > Remote Syslog, pick Custom Syslog Server, point it at the data collector and tick 3CX Alerts. RFC 5424 (the default) and RFC 3164 both work. IP blacklisting by the anti-hacking checks, calls blocked by Country Blocking and administrator password recovery requests go to the third-party alert schema; other EventLog records stay generic. 3CX doesn't publish the format of AuditLog records or a login event, so admin and user logins aren't covered. Samples follow the record 3CX's syslog page shows, with event ids and messages from its event list and made-up values. The child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13, and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there. On 2026-10-14 the child also passed Run Test in a lab tenant as a separate parser under its parent.
